title: Mutungamiriri Akagadzwa weRudzi
intro: Munguva yedambudziko guru uye kusuwa kwevanhu, kugadzwa kwaMwari kwakaitwa. Munhu uyu, uyo pakutanga akaregeredzwa nevakawanda, akasarudzwa naAllah kuti atungamirire rudzi kurwisa muvengi anotyisa. Nyaya yavo inoratidza simba rekutenda neuchenjeri huri shure kwechirevo chaMwari, zvichiratidza kuti hutungamiriri hwechokwadi hahuwanikwe nguva dzose munzvimbo dzinotarisirwa.
clues: Ndakasarudzwa naAllah kuti ndive mutungamiri wevanhu vangu pavakatsvaga mutongi wekurwa muchinangwa Chake.
Vanhu vangu pakutanga vakabvunza nezvekugadzwa kwangu, vachifunga kuti vamwe vaikodzera nekuda kwepfuma yavo kana dzinza ravo.
Chiratidzo chehutungamiriri hwangu hwakarurama kwaive kudzoka kwebhokisi dzvene, rine zvisaririra zvevaprofita vekare, izvo zvakaunza rugare.
Ndakatungamira mauto angu kurwizi, uko ndakaedza kuteerera kwavo nekuvarambidza kunwa mvura inopfuura chipunu chimwe chete.
Pasinei nehuwandu hushoma hweavo vakaramba vakashinga mushure mekuedzwa, takatarisana nemurwi ane simba neuto ravo.
Ndichitungamirirwa neni, mumwe murume wechidiki kubva muuto rangu, uyo akanga asiri murwi ane mukurumbira, akashinga kurwisa muvengi ane simba ndokumukunda.

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Umambo hwakavambwa hune pfuma nesimba guru.
Mhare yemuvengi yakakundwa, uye Allah akapa kukunda.
Kusanaya kwemvura kukuru kwakatambudza nyika kwemakore.
outcome.answer: Mhare yemuvengi yakakundwa, uye Allah akapa kukunda.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
